newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 4.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Tuesday:
WASHINGTON - More than a dozen relatives of U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, including three grandparents, were killed as Jewish victims of the Holocaust.

WASHINGTON - D.C. Mayor Marion Barry warned of severe service cuts if the city's financial control board did not approve his plan to save about $50 million next year by lengthening the time the city takes to repay its debts.
WASHINGTON - Senate Foreign Relations Committee Chairman Jesse Helms is seeking to delay a vote on an international treaty banning chemical weapons.
MOSCOW - Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said he will warn President Clinton that rapid expansion of NATO into central Europe could undermine the government of President Boris Yeltsin.
ISLAMABAD - Nawaz Sharif, forced out as Pakistan's prime minister in 1993, was poised to return to office after an election marked by a record low voter turnout.

HOUSTON - Lawyers are predicting a big legal war will soon explode in Houston after passage of law that calls for brighter lights, nametags and a distance of three feet between a dancer at topless clubs and her admirers.
